description: PAID ($0.50). Charge this sale: should this invoice carry VAT, which country's and how much - place of supply under the EU, UK and South Africa rules, net/VAT/gross, registration threshold, rule cited. Omit buyer_country for single-country rate maths. Anything we cannot answer in full is refused free (coverage_gap, no_charge). Shares the 3 free calls per IP per day with the answer tools. Pass api_key if you have one (card checkout at /pricing); otherwise the result is the x402 payment requirement. Optional receipt (boolean, default false): on a paid success, include an Ed25519 answer receipt at no extra USDC. An answer receipt is not a series certified extract (GET /v1/certified/{country}/{series} is $0.10 and is not an MCP tool) and is not legal advice. Verify with verify_answer_receipt against /certified/public-key.

amount_is.description: net adds VAT (default); gross extracts it

api_key.description: API key (bypasses x402; metered for invoicing)

receipt.description: Default false. When true, a paid success includes an Ed25519 answer receipt (kind answer_receipt) at no extra USDC. Unpaid 402 and free refusals do not include one. Not a series certified extract (GET /v1/certified/{country}/{series} at $0.10; that SKU is not an MCP tool).

seller_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (EL = Greece, UK = United Kingdom)

name: charge_sale

outputSchema.description: Finished-job dossier: verdict or summary, line items, evidence with official sources. On 402 the x402 PaymentRequired object (isError)

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge

payment_required.description: true when the call needs payment; how_to_pay explains x402 or card
